subject: Can I format the number in a numericInput?

messages.author: 2f71cb707147be6f
messages.subject: Can I format the number in a numericInput?
parts:
The line

  numericInput("multiplier", "Multiplier", 100000)

results in 1e+05 in the input box.
I'd like it to be 100000
Is there an easy way to accomplish this?
Or do I have to treat it as a string input and convert to numeric?

Thanks,
David Reiner
